alt: Dense city of pale blocks, green rooftops and steel lattice under cool light, with a curved cream wall on the right.
Through a glass lift cabin window, a steel truss climbs the shaft, with city towers and walkways seen on either side.
Cutaway hub rings and bearings run across black space, with a grey rotor disc on the left and lattice trusses on the right.
A long ship with a tapered nose sits in gold cradles among steel trusses, with a large tube in the foreground.
The grey four-rotor station in black space, rotor names painted on its hull, with the open forward cage and spoked end disc nearest.
A grey cylindrical station shows its spoked end disc at left, with a caged ring section beyond it and a planet above.
